answer: The sable explorer makes public the whole merge tree. Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence since the cipher binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 323 account operation therefore ties up 31 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
